name: v52_vwap_pressure_longer_window
hypothesis: Longer ranking window and slightly slower decay may improve Fitness for the low-correlation VWAP pressure reversal near-miss without moving into close-location capacity.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 40)) + 0.20 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 30)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: Repairs v51 pw65od6V by smoothing the VWAP-pressure signal; no close-location or close/open.

name: v52_vwap_pressure_low_range
hypothesis: Late-session VWAP pressure may reverse more cleanly when recent range is not elevated; replace the volume term with low range.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 30)) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Should be less close-location-like than E5wRYVQR; strict correlation gate required.

name: v52_vwap_pressure_no_volume
hypothesis: The relative-volume term may add turnover without enough Fitness; pure VWAP pressure plus range/risk may be cleaner.
expression: 0.50 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 30)) + 0.20 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: A lower-turnover cleaner variant of v51 VWAP pressure reversal.

name: v52_vwap_pressure_group_ranked
hypothesis: Industry group ranking the VWAP pressure component may improve sub-universe robustness and reduce exposure to broad intraday pressure regimes.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (close - vwap) / close, 30), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 30), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: Tests group_rank instead of global rank; watch strength loss.

name: v52_vwap_pressure_industry_neutral
hypothesis: INDUSTRY neutralization may improve Fitness if MARKET neutralization leaves sector-level VWAP pressure noise.
expression: 0.40 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 30)) + 0.25 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 30)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)

name: v52_vwap_pressure_beta_corr_relief
hypothesis: Combining beta-slope and correlation-slope relief may stabilize the VWAP pressure reversal across sub-universes.
expression: 0.40 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 30)) + 0.20 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Risk-stabilized version; reject if it maps to mL86Jle1 or option/news actives.

name: v52_vwap_pressure_low_turnover_hump
hypothesis: Hump smoothing may preserve VWAP reversal strength while lowering churn enough to improve Fitness.
expression: hump(0.45 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 30)) + 0.20 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 30)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry))
notes: Operator-smoothing probe; kill if hump reduces signal too much.

name: v52_vwap_pressure_abs_stability
hypothesis: Names with smaller absolute VWAP dislocation and low correlation may be stable; this tests whether the near-miss was truly directional or just stability.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(abs(close / vwap - 1), 30)) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: Stability sign-control; likely lower Sharpe but different from directional VWAP pressure.
